title: 第3章 田产第4章 卖青玉梨
content_zh:
;;
三十亩田产的粮一般就够十余口人吃的了。
剩下的钱可以存着买内劲秘籍。
内劲秘籍也有优劣之分。
上乘武学典籍和下乘武学之间，价格相差不少。
当然许川猜测这应当是普通黎庶购买的价格，为的就是让普通人买不起，与前世古代寒门学子读不起书类似。
世家把控武学，也是为了让人去武馆。
习武要有所成，十余年起步，期间药膳等补充气血之物还不能断，这同样是一笔细水长流，钝刀子割肉。
许川不想被掣肘，而今自家又有实力购买，自然想入手一本好的内劲秘籍，未来让自家人打下一个好的武道基础。
至于更珍贵的先天秘籍，那就只能等许家有人诞生先天武者后再考虑了。
“主簿亲自到下面来处理事务，还真是稀罕事？是官场争斗？”
许川思定后，看准时间，直接前往村口候人。
此时，洞溪村。
普通黎庶都在忙着收割水稻后的各种事项。
家底厚实的富户，见天气炎热，若非必要也不想外出。
洞溪村村口。
许川见到不远处走来两位身穿皂衣的衙役和一位青袍文人。
于是赶忙上前，询问来历之后，就提出想要购买于伯家的稻田。
“你要购买五十亩稻田？”清江主簿杨昭诧异道。
他打量着许川，见他粗布麻衣背心，觉得眼前之人应该是洞溪村的一位普通黎庶。

五十亩稻田对于普通黎庶来说可不是小数目。
“你确定买的起？可不要戏弄本官，不然后果不是你承担的起的。”
他此时心情不算多么美妙，语气中带着严厉。
“小的怎敢！”
杨昭思索片刻，给出一个公道价格。
许川当即付清稻田钱款。
今日若换成以往贪婪的主簿，怕是抬高到二十多两一亩都正常。
但真如此，许川也定不会买了，他的钱可不是大风里刮来的，目前一丝一毫都得用到刀刃上。
八月的天气，炎热的着实让人难熬。
杨昭淡淡地瞥了一眼，擦了擦额头的汗，刚入村就把县丞吩咐的事完成了一半，心情好了许多。
虽然他知道这是县丞有意针对自己这位新来的主簿，但官大一级压死人。
他如果今日完不成，回去后定然会被针对。
“你叫什么？”
“许川。”
“查一下。”
“是，杨主簿。”
个高衙役拿出田地官册，查找许川等级的财产，另一位脸庞较圆润的衙役同样拿出人丁册翻找许川的名字。
content_en:
;;
The grain produced by thirty acres of land is usually enough to feed more than ten people.
The remaining money can be saved to buy inner energy secrets.
Internal strength secrets also have their advantages and disadvantages.
There is a big price difference between superior martial arts classics and inferior martial arts books.
Of course, Xu Chuan guessed that this should be the purchase price for ordinary people, so that ordinary people could not afford it, similar to how poor students in ancient times could not afford to study.
The aristocratic family controls martial arts in order to get people to go to the martial arts gym.
To achieve success in martial arts, it takes more than ten years to start. During this period, medicinal foods and other things that replenish qi and blood cannot be cut off. This is also like a long stream of water, and a blunt knife cutting the flesh.
Xu Chuan didn't want to be constrained, and now that his family had the strength to buy it, he naturally wanted to buy a good inner strength secret book so that his family could lay a good foundation for martial arts in the future.
As for the more precious innate secrets, we can only consider them after someone in the Xu family gives birth to an innate warrior.
"Is it really rare for the chief secretary to personally come down to handle affairs? Is it an official battle?"
After Xu Chuan made up his mind, he saw the time and went directly to the entrance of the village to wait for someone.
At this time, Dongxi Village.
Ordinary people are busy with various matters after harvesting rice.
Wealthy households with strong family backgrounds do not want to go out unless necessary when the weather is hot.
The entrance of Dongxi Village.
Xu Chuan saw two government servants wearing soap clothes and a scholar in green robe walking not far away.
So he hurried forward, asked about the origin, and proposed to buy Yu Bo's rice field.
"You want to buy fifty acres of rice fields?" Yang Zhao, the chief secretary of Qingjiang, asked in surprise.
He looked at Xu Chuan, saw his coarse linen vest, and felt that the person in front of him must be an ordinary commoner from Dongxi Village.
Fifty acres of rice fields is not a small amount for ordinary people.
"Are you sure you can afford it? Don't tease me, otherwise you won't be able to bear the consequences."
He was not in a very good mood at this time, and his tone was stern.
"How dare you, little one!"
Yang Zhao thought for a moment and gave a fair price.
Xu Chuan immediately paid off the rice fields.
Today, if it were the greedy master bookkeeper in the past, it would be normal to raise the price to more than 20 taels and one acre.
But if this is the case, Xu Chuan will definitely not buy it. His money does not come from the strong wind. At present, every bit of it must be used wisely.
The weather in August is really unbearably hot.
Yang Zhao glanced lightly, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and completed half of what the county magistrate ordered as soon as he entered the village, and he felt much better.
Although he knew that this was the county magistrate's intention to target his new chief secretary, the official level was overwhelming.
If he can't finish it today, he will definitely be targeted when he returns.
"What's your name?"
"Xu Chuan."
"Check it out."
"Yes, Master Yang."
A high-ranking yamen official took out the official land register and searched for the property of Xu Chuan's rank. Another yamen official with a rounder face also took out the personnel register and searched for Xu Chuan's name.
